run.scope: Store and currencies, boosters and slots, Level Complete rewards, player XP and level locks, player name. Read from the source code and the live build.
run.summary: A casual web puzzle game: bees eat a pixel picture color by color from limited slots. Players earn coins by winning levels and spend coins and gems on boosters and speed; real-money items are test purchases in this build.

inputs.ref: Pixel Swarm repository: js/app.js, js/data.js, index.html (inventory/rules.md)

risks: Currencies and purchases: a wrong charge or a lost reward breaks trust
No Ads is a paid entitlement and must never be sold twice
Slot limits decide whether a level is fair
Level-gated content must unlock through play
run.existing_tests: A debug self-test in the game (js/app.js around line 2700 and 2890: save slots, report form). No automated test suite in the repository.

rules.text: Coin packs bought with gems: 1,000 for 30 gems, 5,000 for 120, 12,000 for 250
Not enough gems for a coin pack: toast 'Not enough gems (need <price>)' and nothing changes
Special Offer $4.99: +1,200 gems, +10,000 coins and No Ads
No Ads $2.99; once owned the card shows a disabled 'Owned' button
Free Coins: +100 per video, 5 per local day; the button is disabled at 0 left
Restore: 'No Ads is already active' when owned, else 'No purchases to restore (test mode)'

features.name: Boosters and slots
features.risk_reason: Boosters decide whether a level can be won; they are bought with currency

rules.text: Unlock levels: Add Slot at 0, Shuffle at 11, Wind at 14, Free Pick at 16 completed levels
Using a booster with none left: toast 'No <name> left'
Add Slot stops at 7 slots: toast 'Maximum slots reached'
Out of Slots offers +1 slot after a video ad (fail-addslot); this path has no slot check

features.name: Level Complete and rewards
features.risk_reason: The reward for every win; ads shown between wins

rules.text: Win reward: 30 coins easy, 45 medium, 60 hard
Claim x2 doubles the reward after a video ad; Continue pays it once
A video ad every 2 wins in a row, unless No Ads is owned or Claim x2 was used
Pop-ups marked data-locked close only by code; Out of Slots has it, Level Complete does not. A tap on the dark overlay closes an unlocked pop-up

features.name: Player XP and level locks
features.risk_reason: Avatars, skins and wardrobe items unlock at player levels

rules.text: New player: level 1, XP bar out of 2
Items locked below a player level show 'Unlocks at player level <n>'
Only the debug menu changes playerLevel or xp; no gameplay code adds XP
rules.source: js/app.js:2611-2612; search for 'state.xp' finds no increment

rules.text: The name field accepts up to 14 characters

features.name: Release build
features.risk_reason: The debug menu gives free currency; it must not ship

rules.text: The build script sets DEBUG to false for a release build; the DBG button is hidden when DEBUG is false

features.gaps: One build switch: a happy case and a negative case cover it; no edge input.

cases.title: Buying 1,000 coins for 30 gems moves the exact amounts
cases.priority_reason: Currency exchange: every number must be exact
preconditions: Fresh save, then 100 gems and 0 coins (debug: zero, then gems)
expected: Gems 100 -> 70, coins 0 -> 1,000, in the HUD and in the save (localStorage pixelswarm.save.v1)

automation.reason: Exact numbers readable from the save; runs on every change

cases.title: Coin pack with too few gems is refused and nothing changes
cases.priority_reason: A refused purchase must never charge
preconditions: 29 gems, 0 coins (debug: zero, then gems; spend to 29, or edit the save)
cases.data: 29 gems vs a 30-gem pack (one below the price)

cases.title: Coin pack with exactly the price in gems leaves 0 gems
Each gem pack adds its exact amount
cases.priority_reason: Paid items in the real app

cases.title: No Ads purchase removes the banner and shows Owned
preconditions: Fresh save, No Ads not owned
expected: The No Ads card shows a disabled 'Owned' button
After reload: still Owned, no banner in a level

cases.title: A player who owns No Ads is not sold No Ads again in the Special Offer
cases.priority_reason: Charging twice for an entitlement is a refund and trust problem
steps: Look at the Special Offer card
expected: The offer either hides No Ads, shows it as owned, or is replaced; its price is not charged for No Ads again

automation.reason: Cheap check once the rule is decided

cases.source: R-STORE-4 and R-STORE-5: the No Ads card checks state.noAds (js/app.js:324) but the offer card (js/app.js:314-318) does not; the offer pop-up does (js/app.js:698)
cases.assumption: An owned entitlement should not be sold again (Q-01)

cases.title: Special Offer grants 1,200 gems, 10,000 coins and No Ads
preconditions: Fresh save: 0 gems, 0 coins, No Ads not owned
expected: Toast 'Test purchase: +1,200 gems, +10,000 coins, No Ads'

cases.title: Free Coins stop after the 5th video of the day
cases.priority_reason: Daily cap on a free currency source
expected: The card says '0 left today' and the Watch button is disabled

automation.reason: Boundary at 5; the test ad must be skippable in tests

cases.title: Free Coins reset at the player's local midnight
steps: Move the device clock to the next local day (or the browser clock in the test)
expected: The card says '5 left today' and Watch is enabled

cases.title: Restore purchases says No Ads is active when owned
cases.priority_reason: Test-mode message only in this build

cases.title: Double tap on a coin pack charges once
cases.priority_reason: Double charges are a classic store bug
steps: Double tap the 1,000 coins pack quickly
expected: Either one purchase (gems 70, coins 1,000) or two clearly confirmed purchases (gems 40, coins 2,000); never a charge without the coins

automation.reason: Decide first whether two quick taps should mean two purchases (Q-02)

cases.source: error-guessing: buy() has no pending guard (js/app.js:374-394)
cases.assumption: Each tap is a separate purchase today; a confirm step may be wanted (Q-02)

cases.title: Add Slot adds one slot and uses one booster
preconditions: In a level with the default slots, 1 Add Slot booster

cases.title: Add Slot at 7 slots is refused and does not use a booster
preconditions: In a level, 7 slots already (add slots until 7), at least 1 Add Slot left

cases.title: +1 slot from Out of Slots respects the same 7-slot limit
cases.priority_reason: Two paths to one limit should agree
preconditions: In a level with 7 slots, run out of slots (debug: lose)
steps: On Out of Slots, tap the +1 slot option
expected: No eighth slot is added, or the option is not offered at 7

automation.reason: Same boundary as TC-BOOST-002 on the other path

cases.source: R-BOOST-4: js/app.js:2681 pushes a slot without the check at js/app.js:2122
cases.assumption: 7 is the limit for every path (Q-03)

cases.title: Using a booster with none left shows 'No <name> left'
preconditions: In a level, 0 Shuffle boosters, Shuffle unlocked
expected: The line of blocks does not change

cases.title: Shuffle unlocks at exactly 11 completed levels
steps: With 10 levels completed, start a level and look at Shuffle
Start a level and look at Shuffle
expected: On the 11th win: 'New Booster!' pop-up for Shuffle

automation.reason: Boundary; reachable with the debug win cheat (assisted)

cases.title: Tapping a locked booster says when it unlocks
steps: In a level, tap the locked Wind booster

cases.title: Continue on Level Complete pays the difficulty reward once
expected: Coins 0 -> 30 in the HUD and the save

automation.reason: Data-driven over three difficulties; win with the debug cheat (assisted)

cases.title: Claim x2 pays double after the video
cases.priority_reason: Reward tied to an ad view

cases.title: Tapping outside Level Complete does not lose the reward
cases.priority_reason: A lost reward on every stray tap is a serious player-facing failure
preconditions: 0 coins, Level Complete open after a win
steps: Tap the dark area outside the Level Complete window
expected: The pop-up stays open, or the reward is paid and the game moves on

cases.title: A video ad plays after every second win in a row

Win the next level and tap Continue
expected: No ad after the first win
A test ad after the second win, then the next level starts

cases.title: No ad between wins when No Ads is owned
steps: Win two levels in a row with Continue
expected: No video ad at any point

cases.title: Claim x2 does not count toward the next forced ad
preconditions: No Ads not owned, 1 win since the last ad
steps: Tap Claim x2 and finish the ad
expected: No second ad after the reward ad

cases.title: Winning levels raises player XP and level

cases.source: R-XP-1, R-XP-2, R-XP-3: the bar and the locks exist, but no gameplay code adds XP

cases.title: A level-locked skin cannot be bought below its level

steps: At level n-1, tap the skin
expected: At n: the skin can be bought or equipped

cases.title: A 14-character name is saved in full

An empty or spaces-only name falls back to a default

Close the profile and reopen it
expected: A default name is shown, never an empty label

questions.question: Should the Special Offer still include No Ads, at full price, for players who already own No Ads?
questions.why: Players would pay again for an entitlement they have

questions.question: Should two quick taps on a store item make two purchases, or should there be a confirm step?
Is 7 the slot limit for every way of adding a slot, including the Out of Slots offer?
questions.why: The two paths disagree in code

questions.question: Should Level Complete be closable by tapping outside it? If yes, should the reward still be paid?
questions.why: The reward and the next level depend on Continue or Claim x2

questions.question: How is XP earned, and how much per win? No gameplay code adds XP.
questions.why: Level-gated skins, avatars and wardrobe items cannot unlock through play

questions.question: What should the profile show when the name is empty or only spaces?

not_covered.area: Puzzle rules, level solvability, save system, daily rewards, events, settings, UI layout
not_covered.reason: Outside this run's scope. The test-puzzles, test-progression, test-settings and test-ui skills cover them
This build uses test purchases; the store integration of the phone app is not built yet
